An active user is defined as a user who has had at least one session during the week (i.e., their session count is greater than 0). We can determine the number of active users by counting how many elements in the input list are strictly greater than zero.

Confidence Level: 100%

```python
def count_active(sessions):
    """
    Returns the number of active users (users with at least 1 session).
    """
    return sum(1 for count in sessions if count > 0)
```
